# A timer whose @tick body calls an async native produces an async
# $timer_N_tick function in the generated JS.
# The $timer_N_sync wrapper (which just calls tick + setTimeout) stays sync.

sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html --out=out app.sngl
exists out/index.html

# Timer tick function is async because the body awaits fetchHello.
grep 'async function \$timer_0_tick' out/index.html

# The async native is awaited inside the tick body.
grep 'await fetchHello' out/index.html

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:app"
import api "js:./api"

component main {
    var running = true
    var last = ""
    timer(interval=500ms, enabled=running, @tick {
        last = api.fetchHello("poll")
    })
    text(value=last)
}

-- api/index.ts --
export async function fetchHello(url: string): Promise<string> { return "data"; }
